steps.title: Prepare oligo pools
steps.instruction: Resuspend oligos or oPools to the specified concentrations in IDTE pH 8.0 and create intermediate pools at the indicated nanomolar concentrations per probe.

substeps.instruction: If using individual oligos ordered in tubes: resuspend each oligo to 100 µM in IDTE pH 8.0 (1 L IDTE pH 8.0, Integrated DNA Technologies, Catalog #11-05-01-09) and combine to an intermediate pool at 3200 nM per probe.
If using oPools: resuspend each 50 pmol‑scale oPool in 31.25 µL to obtain 1600 nM per probe.

steps.title: Prepare primers
steps.instruction: Obtain forward and reverse TruSeq primers, standard desalting, supplied in IDTE (or low‑EDTA TE) buffer.

substeps.instruction: Forward primer (TruSeq Read 1): 5'-CTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATCT-3'
Reverse primer (TruSeq Read 2): 5'-GTGACTGGAGTTCAGACGTGTG-3'

steps.title: Obtain gapfill probe sequences
steps.instruction: Use the following probe designs for gapfill reactions (order as described in the GitHub repository).

substeps.instruction: LHS Probe: 5'-GTGACTGGAGTTCAGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATCT-25N-3' (TruSeq Read 2 handle + 25 N mRNA‑targeting sequence).
RHS Probe: /5Phos/-25N-ACGCGGTTAGCACGTA-NN-8N-CGGTCCTAGCAA-3' (25 N mRNA‑targeting sequence + constant sequence).
Constant Sequence Probe (barcode 8 bp, partial capture sequence 1, truncated version): /5Phos/-25N-8N-CGGTCCTAGCAA-3'

steps.title: Prepare custom probe working solution
steps.instruction: Thaw spike‑in/custom probes on ice, combine panels to a working concentration of 533.3 nM per probe; prepare fresh the same day.

steps.title: Add custom probes during hybridization
steps.instruction: During step 1 of the 10x Genomics Probe Hybridization, add 3 µL of the custom probe mix to achieve a final concentration of 32 nM per probe (for GEM‑X V1).

steps.title: Hybridization incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the hybridization reaction for 16–24 h at 42 °C in a thermal cycler (heated lid, no shaking) as per the 10x protocol.

steps.title: Prepare Post‑Hyb Resuspension Buffer B
steps.instruction: Make Buffer B on ice, supplement with RNase inhibitor to a final concentration of 0.2 U/µL.

substeps.instruction: 1 sample: 475 µL water + 25 µL concentrated Post‑Hyb buffer B + 2.5 µL RNase inhibitor.
2 samples: 950 µL water + 50 µL buffer B + 5 µL RNase inhibitor.
4 samples: 1900 µL water + 100 µL buffer B + 10 µL RNase inhibitor.

steps.title: Resuspend after washes
steps.instruction: After post‑hybridization washes, resuspend each sample in 250 µL of the prepared Post‑Hyb Resuspension Buffer B.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the resuspended sample through a 30 µm pre‑separation filter (Miltenyi Biotec, 130‑041‑407) into a 1.5 mL Protein LoBind tube.

steps.title: Pellet cells
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Aliquot cells for gapfill
steps.instruction: Aliquot 100 000–120 000 cells (or nuclei) into a 0.5 mL or 1.5 mL Protein LoBind tube (or plate if using a swinging‑bucket centrifuge). Do not exceed 120 000 cells per gapfill reaction; split into multiple reactions if needed.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 850 × g, 4 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Add Gapfill Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 100 µL of Gapfill Reaction Mix (Step 10 of the 10x protocol) and transfer to PCR tubes or a 96‑well plate if required.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 850 × g, 4 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Remove excess supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully aspirate 235 µL of supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Final resuspension before encapsulation
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 36.7 µL of Post‑Hyb Resuspension Buffer B. Optionally filter again (resuspend in 150 µL and filter through a 30 µm filter) to avoid clumping.

steps.title: Count cells and pool
steps.instruction: Estimate cell/nuclei concentration with a cell counter and pool samples as recommended by 10x Genomics.

steps.title: Proceed to GEM encapsulation
steps.instruction: Immediately load the cell suspension into the 10x Genomics Flex GEM‑X system for encapsulation.

steps.title: Supplement Pre‑Amp Mix
steps.instruction: Add 50 µM TruSeq Read 2 Reverse primer to the Pre‑Amp Mix: 2.0 µL for a 1× reaction or 8.8 µL for a 4× reaction (final 1 µM in Pre‑Amp Mix) together with the sample from step 4.1 of Post‑GEM Incubation‑Recovery.

steps.title: Adjust Pre‑Amp cycling
steps.instruction: Add two extra cycles to the Pre‑Amp PCR; reduce the indexing PCR cycles for the whole‑transcriptome library by 1–2 cycles to avoid over‑amplification.

steps.title: Pre‑Amp cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform DNA cleanup using the 10x Genomics SPRIselect protocol (step 4.3). Store the cleaned product at 4 °C or –20 °C as a stopping point.

steps.title: Prepare Gapfill PCR master mix
steps.instruction: On ice, assemble the Gapfill Feature PCR master mix according to the desired reaction scale (1×, 1× + 10 %, 2× + 10 %, or 4× + 10 %).

substeps.instruction: Reagents (per 80 µL 1× mix): 50 µL 2 Amp Mix (PN‑2000047 or PN‑2001311), 1 µL forward primer (100 µM stock, final 1 µM), 1 µL reverse primer (100 µM stock, final 1 µM), 28 µL nuclease‑free water.
For 1× + 10 % (88 µL total): add 2.5 µL water (final 30.8 µL water).
For 2× + 10 % (176 µL total): add 4 µL water (final 61.6 µL water).
For 4× + 10 % (352 µL total): add 8 µL water (final 123.2 µL water).

steps.title: Combine pre‑Amp product with Gapfill mix
steps.instruction: Mix 20 µL of the clean Pre‑Amp product with 80 µL of the Gapfill Feature PCR master mix, pipette thoroughly, and briefly centrifuge.

steps.title: Run Gapfill Feature PCR
steps.instruction: Thermal‑cycle the reaction with the following program:

substeps.instruction: Lid temperature 105 °C, 50 µL, ~30 min.
Repeat steps 2–5 nine additional times (total 10 cycles).
6) Hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: SPRIselect cleanup after Gapfill PCR
steps.instruction: Purify the Gapfill PCR product using SPRIselect beads (1.8× ratio).

substeps.instruction: Vortex SPRIselect reagent, add 180 µL to each sample, pipette mix 15×, incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Place tube on a high‑strength magnet, add 300 µL 80 % ethanol, wait 30 s, remove ethanol (do NOT discard beads).
Add 200 µL 80 % ethanol, wait 30 s, remove ethanol.
Briefly centrifuge, keep tube on low‑strength magnet until solution clears.
Transfer 30.6 µL supernatant to a new tube strip.
Place on low magnet until clear, remove any residual ethanol (do NOT let beads dry).
Remove from magnet, add 31 µL Buffer EB (Qiagen #19086), pipette mix 15×, incubate 2 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add Amp Mix for Gapfill library
steps.instruction: To each clean Gapfill library, add 50 µL Amp Mix (PN‑2000047 or PN‑2001311) and water to bring the total volume to 80 µL. Use the entire Gapfill library volume; store any leftovers at –20 °C for up to 4 weeks.

steps.title: Add dual index primers
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of an individual Dual Index TT Set A (PN‑300431) to each sample, pipette mix 5× (set pipette to 90 µL), and briefly centrifuge.

steps.title: Run sample index PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify with the same thermal‑cycling program used for indexing the Flex Gene Expression library (determine cycle number from the 10x User Guide).

substeps.instruction: 5) Repeat steps 2–4 for the determined number of cycles.
7) Hold at 4 °C.
Note: Reduce 1–2 cycles for whole‑transcriptome libraries because the pre‑amp cycle number was increased.

steps.title: Post‑index PCR SPRIselect cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify the indexed library using SPRIselect beads at a 0.8× ratio.

substeps.instruction: Vortex SPRIselect reagent, add 80 µL to each sample, pipette mix 15×, incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Place tube on a high‑strength magnet until solution clears, then remove supernatant (keep beads).
With tube on magnet, add 200 µL 80 % ethanol, wait 30 s, remove ethanol. Repeat for a total of two washes.
Remove any remaining ethanol (do NOT let beads dry).
Place on low‑strength magnet until clear, remove from magnet, add 41 µL Buffer EB, pipette mix 15×, incubate 2 min at room temperature.
Place on low magnet until clear, transfer 40.6 µL to a new tube strip.
Store the final library at 4 °C or –20 °C (long‑term storage).

steps.title: Library quality control
steps.instruction: Run 1 µL of the final library diluted 1:20 on an Agilent TapeStation High Sensitivity D1000 tape; expect a peak size of 250–260 bp.

steps.title: Sequencing parameters
steps.instruction: Sequence the Gapfill library together with Flex WTA libraries using one of the following read configurations and calculate required reads.

substeps.instruction: Option 1: Read 1 = 48 bp, i7 = 10 bp, i5 = 10 bp, Read 2 = 50 bp.
Option 2: Read 1 = 28 bp, i7 = 10 bp, i5 = 10 bp, Read 2 = 90 bp (increase Read 2 length to capture full probe or barcode as needed).
Required reads = 100 × (number of probes) × (number of cells).
Include ~9 % PhiX spike‑in (adjustable based on other libraries in the pool).
